info.title: AI Tutor Platform API
info.description:
API for course-scoped AI tutoring, course materials, student memory, and learning support workflows.

LUU Y CHO FE MOBILE: Cac luong AI (student-chat, answer-review, teacher-answer, senior-approval) goi qua n8n webhook (http://10.0.2.2:5678/webhook/...), KHONG nam trong spec REST nay. Payment/Subscription bi @Hidden khoi Swagger. JWT hien dang TAT.

servers.description: Android emulator -> host machine (dùng cho Flutter Android emulator)
Thiet bi that - DOI thanh IP LAN cua may chay backend

delete.summary: Delete one course material and its indexed chunks

answer.description: Answer sent back to the student

createKnowledgeCandidate.description: True only when this answer contains reusable academic knowledge that may become AI brain knowledge after senior approval

candidateType.description: ACADEMIC_KNOWLEDGE, MATERIAL_CORRECTION, FAQ_CLARIFICATION, OPERATIONAL_POLICY, GRADING_DECISION, CLASS_RULE, ASSIGNMENT_SPECIFIC

MentorAnswerRequest.description: Teacher or mentor answer for an escalation

reviewerId.description: Reviewer ID. Must not be the same as the mentor who created the answer.

reviewerRole.description: Reviewer role. Only SENIOR_MENTOR or ADMIN can approve knowledge for AI learning.

contentOverride.description: Optional corrected content to index instead of the original candidate content

KnowledgeCandidateReviewRequest.description: Senior mentor review request for a knowledge candidate

conversationId.description: Conversation ID returned by AI query/code mentor

questionEscalationId.description: Escalation ticket ID if this review belongs to an escalation answer

mode.description: AI mode being reviewed: RAG, CODE_MENTOR, or ESCALATE

reviewType.description: Review type: QUALITY_FEEDBACK, ANSWER_DISPUTE, SOURCE_CONFLICT, MISSING_MATERIAL, OPERATIONAL_POLICY, GRADING_DECISION, CLASS_RULE, ASSIGNMENT_SPECIFIC

answer.description: AI or mentor answer being reviewed

accurate.description: Whether the reviewer thinks the answer is correct

helpful.description: Whether the answer helped the student

suggestedCorrection.description: Suggested correction when answer is incomplete or wrong

reviewerRole.description: STUDENT, HUMAN_REVIEWER, MENTOR, SENIOR_MENTOR, or ADMIN

AiAnswerReviewRequest.description: Human review for an AI answer after RAG, Code Mentor, or Escalation flow

createKnowledgeCandidate.description: If true, create a pending KnowledgeCandidate from the correction. It is not indexed until approved.

candidateType.description: Knowledge type when creating a candidate: ACADEMIC_KNOWLEDGE, MATERIAL_CORRECTION, or FAQ_CLARIFICATION

correctedAnswer.description: Corrected content to use for the knowledge candidate

SeniorReviewResolutionRequest.description: Senior mentor resolution for a human AI answer review

question.description: Student question about the code or error

assignmentRelated.description: True if this is related to an assignment/homework

question.description: Student question. Use either question or message; message has higher priority when both are provided.

message.description: Alias of question for chat/n8n clients. Use either message or question; do not send different values in both fields.

codeSnippet.description: Optional code snippet or error log. When present, intent classifier may route to CODE_MENTOR mode.

courseId.description: Course ID for course-scoped RAG search

classId.description: Optional class section ID for memory/escalation context. RAG search is currently scoped by courseId.

conversationId.description: Existing conversation ID. Omit this field for the first message; reuse the returned conversationId to continue the chat.
